# 09-session-sandbox-rebuilt.png — prompt

Style (shared series system): landscape 16:9 (1672x941). Warm off-white paper background, charcoal typography and outlines. Accents only from: cobalt blue, vermilion, teal, mustard. Crisp geometric editorial illustration, subtle depth, generous negative space. Minimal LARGE text labels exactly as quoted; icons carry secondary meaning. Causal arrows and containment boundaries. Avoid: dashboards, ornamental circuitry, photorealism, tiny labels, decorative AI glow.

Composition: three vertical layers with containment boundaries. Top layer: "TEMPLATE — REBUILT AT EVERY DEPLOY" in cobalt, shown as a stamp being freshly re-cut, with small chips inside labeled "DEPS", "TOOLS", "BASELINE"; a small key icon labeled "REVALIDATION KEY" triggers the re-cut. Middle layer: two session boxes stamped from it, labeled "SESSION", each with a thin teal top-coat layer labeled "SCRATCH STATE ONLY". Right of one session: a snapshot card labeled "SNAPSHOT" with a mustard countdown ring labeled "EXPIRES 30 DAYS", visibly fading at the edge. Bottom caption: "NOTHING IS EVER HAND-PATCHED — UPDATES ARE FREE, PERMANENCE IS NOT THE PRODUCT". The inversion of graphic 07: the computer is disposable, only the session's thin layer persists, briefly.
